title: ConnectionsSetHostModeResult
description: Result of the connections.setHostMode JSON-RPC method: the method now in force for the connection's host, and — when the record could not be persisted — the sentence that says so. The method stands for this run either way, because the store keeps a failed write in memory; note is present only when it will not survive a restart.

profileId.description: The connection the write was made for.

mode.description: The method in force after the call.

note.description: A sentence for the person when the host's record could not be saved: the method applies to this run, and the host will be answered again after a restart. Absent when the record was written.
